shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"list_sessions|list_conversations|createMessageHandler|IncomingMessage|SessionSummary\" src specs package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
sed -n '1,240p' src/types/messages.ts
sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,150p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '1,130p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
sed -n '1,110p' src/transport/createServer.ts
sed -n '85,140p' src/index.ts
sed -n '1,115p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "lore-query-trace --repo re-cinq/HALEngine --tests_covering src/types/messages.ts --ranges 1-70 || true
lore-query-trace --repo re-cinq/HALEngine --tests_covering src/transport/ws/validation.ts --ranges 1-75 || true
sed -n '1,120p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
rg -n \"specs/.*#\" src --glob '*test.ts' | head -80
sed -n '1,180p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|spec:\" scripts/lore-* src --glob '*test.ts' | head -120
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
nl -ba src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts | sed -n '1,80p'
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '68,86p'
git diff --check && git diff"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
rg -n \"@spec|specs/.*#\" . --glob '*.test.ts' --glob '*.test.js' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' | head -160
rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|spec-link'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts --runInBand && nl -ba src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts | sed -n '20,36p' && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts && git commit -m "Add list session protocol types" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git status --short; fi && git status --short --branch && git log -1 --oneline'
